name: derail-the-pitch-copilot
description:
Derail the Pitch® Copilot helps creative studio founders find out whether they're the favorite or just filler before spending weeks on a competitive pitch. It counts red flags and green lights, and helps founders reshape the opportunity or walk away.

Signed-in Forum members get full coaching that uses their studio's Centerfile. Without signing in, it runs in a limited diagnostic mode.

A Forum AI Copilot by Joel Pilger.

interface.shortDescription: Know if you can win the pitch

positive.expected_behavior: Calls whoAmI and confirms full power mode for the signed-in member.

positive.description: Load the Centerfile at session start
positive.prompt: We just got invited to a pitch.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms access, loads the default Centerfile by name, and asks about the pitch.

positive.prompt: A brand invited five studios to pitch, wants spec work, and we've never met the decision maker. Are we the favorite or just filler?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives an honest read on the studio's odds with the reasons.

positive.prompt: Count red flags vs green lights for this pitch: tight deadline, no budget shared, existing relationship with the CMO.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists red flags and green lights and gives a recommendation.
Explains the Copilot's purpose and how to start.

negative.description: Unrelated request outside the Copilot's purpose
